messages:
noor: Seeing a spike in 502/connection rejects for streaming clients in eu-west-1 and eu-central. Error traces point to header decoding failures in the ingress LD library after yesterday's vendored update.

ops-bot: Incident created: INCIDENT-2026-0815-02 — ingress header encoding regression. Status page: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INCIDENT-2026-0815-02 :rotating_light: 

felix: Oncall taking. Reproduced locally: certain header sequences (chunked metadata + null bytes) cause the ingress lib to NACK the connection. Likely regression in header sanitizer.

sre: Affected traffic: streaming websocket and grpc streams carrying long metadata blobs. Hosted eu pools primarily; no reports from Dedicated yet.

support: Tickets coming in from customers using streaming SDKs. Preparing an external blurb: short, clear, include mitigation and ETA.

felix: Mitigation plan: 1) roll back vendored LD to previous release on eu-hosted ingress, 2) temporarily disable streaming handoff for metadata >8KB and fall back to polling, 3) increase ingress retries to avoid user-visible failures. Rolling rollback now in waves.

ops-bot: Rollback wave 1 (15% hosts) applied @3155556742; partial recovery observed on rolled hosts (~60% error reduction).

noor: Can we add an ingress rule to rewrite troublesome metadata sequences to a safe placeholder for now? That could reduce customer impact while rollback completes.

felix: Added a temporary sanitizer rule at the edge to strip null bytes from metadata headers for streams from eu region. Rule: 
```
ingress.sanitizer.strip_chars = "\u0000"
```
Applied to eu ingress.

support: Draft message: "We are investigating increased connection errors for streaming clients in EU regions. Mitigations in progress: rollback of a recent library update and temporary streaming restrictions for large metadata. No data loss. We expect reduced errors within 30-45 minutes." Approve?

noor: Approve. Post update to status page and notify SDK teams to prepare a patch for graceful fallback.

incident-bot: Status page updated: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INCIDENT-2026-0815-02 — Mitigations: rollback + metadata sanitizer + streaming fallback.

felix: Rollback wave 2 (~50% hosts) complete @3155556865. Error rates trending toward baseline; still monitoring for residual rejects.

sre: Current impact: ~7 customers with >2% streaming error rate, 2 with brief user-visible outages. Support is contacting them directly. No writes or inference lost.

ops-bot: Monitoring window started: 20 minutes for post-mitigation verification.

noor: Next actions: keep sanitizer for 2 hours, coordinate with SDK to land graceful metadata handling, schedule RCA to avoid future vendoring blindspots.

support: Sending out customer follow-ups now and will close incident when verification window passes.

felix: Thanks team — Ill own the rollback verification and follow up with a detailed timeline and next steps in the postmortem. :white_check_mark:
